correctness.rationale: For every finite N and positive rates, dissipativity makes undamped modes exactly the Hermitian eigenvectors vanishing at both monitored sites; the contractive propagator rules out real-axis Jordan blocks. The plane-wave spectrum is degenerate only at zero and half-flux; pair nodal compatibility is L dividing the pair frequency. A parity count gives all dark dimensions and finite cosine/geometric sums give the full sitewise formula. The independent standalone numerical matrix verifier checked 195 N/separation/phase instances and twice as many loss-rate spectra; tests support rather than replace the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The exact two-contact placement and flux switch resolve a natural physical design question for quantum detection on rings. For even N the insertion of half flux can eliminate all permanent dark modes or create an extra one depending only on N/gcd(N,s). Exact all-starting-site weights discriminate different initial excitations and are independent of loss strengths. This is a structural all-size classification in an interference-sensitive model rather than a parameter renaming or isolated numerical example.
